title: Pre-Decoding Acoustic Triage for Budgeted Vision-Language Captioning of Untrimmed Egocentric Video
abstract: arXiv:2608.22359v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatically analyzing hours-long egocentric video is increasingly essential for progress monitoring, quality control, and safety in logistics, construction, and manufacturing. Yet current pipelines that process short, fixed-size windows with a vision-language model (VLM) are prohibitively expensive because cost scales with the number of model calls. To reduce this cost, prior work proposes triage policies to select which windows merit a VLM invocation. However, these policies either sample uniformly or rank windows using visual features, which ironically requires the video decoding that the budget constraints are meant to avoid. We propose audio-first triage: select windows using the lightest modality, scored before any video frame is decoded, so the approach composes naturally with token compression or quantization. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22359v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：自动分析数小时的自我中心视频对于物流、建筑和制造业中的进度监控、质量控制和安全性日益重要。然而，当前处理短视频、固定大小窗口并使用视觉-语言模型（VLM）的流程成本过高，因为成本随模型调用次数增加而增长。为降低此成本，先前工作提出了分流策略，以选择哪些窗口值得进行VLM调用。然而，这些策略要么均匀采样，要么使用视觉特征对窗口进行排名，这讽刺地需要视频解码，而预算约束本意是避免这一点的。我们提出音频优先分流：使用最轻量的模态选择窗口，在任何视频帧解码前进行评分，因此该方法自然与令牌压缩或量化相结合。创新点在于目标，而非表示：我们训练的不是逐帧声音事件检测器，而是...
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于音频的预解码分流方法，在视频解码前利用轻量级音频模态选择关键窗口，以大幅降低视觉-语言模型在未裁剪自我中心视频字幕生成中的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an audio-first pre-decoding triage method that selects key windows using the lightweight audio modality before video decoding, significantly reducing the computational cost of vision-language captioning for untrimmed egocentric video.
